purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for the Pallas bypass-custody dependency fixture.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for Stores Collar Six, ordinary mixed-body inventory work, the AU recall, the Kappa-6 condensate fault, bypass deployment, and four state-gated custody outcomes.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the room establishing view, worker and equipment introduction, each ordinary preparation action, the inventory fold, the recall notice, Ilya's entrance, the recall choice, the amber fault, bypass action, held-fault state, custody threshold, and each ending family.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt is a complete standalone description for a general image model. It names visible geometry, materials, lighting, bodies, equipment, and staging. Character refs repeat stable identity during prompt assembly; continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: bleak painterly industrial science-fiction illustration for interactive fiction, charcoal and oxidized orange with restrained cyan instrument light, tactile scuffed metal and patched polymer, expressive body posture, legible machinery, humane dry wit, cinematic 16:9 composition, non-photoreal but physically coherent.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each generated prompt from global_style_cue, visual refs only for named characters visible in that frame, the complete scene base_image_prompt, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Use the scene_set camera slot as geometry authority and omit visual_continuity_notes from prompt text.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture stays inside one curved service collar and supplies fixed zones, routes, sightlines, staging slots, occluders, and camera slots. This supports draft illustrated replay without treating generated concept art as room geometry.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: For high-consistency website rendering, convert this inline plan into a simple 3D blockout and feed each named camera render to the image model as painterly input.

orrin_dax.stable_visual_description: Broad older baseline human with light-brown weathered skin, close-cropped graying hair, rough stubble, and a pale frost scar along one side of the jaw. Wears a patched brown-and-orange anchor-crew jacket, heavy gloves, magnetic boots, and stays near an old anchor cart, orange haulback line, and battered dark metal coffee mug.
orrin_dax.silhouette_notes: Solid guarded build, slightly hunched from rail work, visually tied to cart, rescue line, gloves, and mug.
do_not_change: anchor cart and orange haulback line

nara_7.species_or_body: VitaForge BioDrone Standard engineered humanoid seal technician
nara_7.stable_visual_description: Slender engineered humanoid with smooth androgynous features, pale gray-brown skin, close-cropped dark hair, faint subdermal route-interface lines at wrists and neck, and a clean gray numbered seal-technician skinsuit with a small VitaForge batch tag. Hands move with precise economical contact sequences.
nara_7.silhouette_notes: Narrow still posture, hands often flat on panels or spanning valve contacts.
do_not_change: faint wrist and neck interface lines

lio_vale.stable_visual_description: Lean compact adult baseline human with medium-brown skin, short black hair clipped close at the sides, tired dark eyes, and controlled practical posture. Wears a worn slate-gray AU maintenance jacket, soft-soled magnetic boots, utility belt with tags and seals, and carries a scuffed rectangular work slate.
lio_vale.silhouette_notes: Shoulders slightly forward, usually placed between worker routes and authority while holding the slate low.

ilya_marne.stable_visual_description: Tall baseline human woman with cool light skin, severe silver-blonde hair pinned tight, sharp cheekbones, and a controlled corporate expression. Wears a clean dark AU superintendent coat with pale blue trim, polished magnetic boots, and a slim supervisor console cuff.
ilya_marne.silhouette_notes: Vertical polished stance associated with badge stair, cage lock, glass operations strip, and blue-white authority screens.
do_not_change: dark superintendent coat with pale blue trim

review_notes: The inline scene_set fixes radial and ring-relative directions, component routes, body staging, sightlines, occluders, and camera slots for one-room multi-angle replay.
Every base prompt repeats visible character appearance and room geometry so it can stand alone; prompt assembly still applies stable refs only for visible named characters.
Generated imagery is deferred. For website-quality continuity, image generation should paint over camera-specific renders from a simple blockout derived from the inline plan.
